data.message: Heading to lower engine for my last task.

I reported Diana’s body in lower engine. My route was oxygen → upper engine → medbay → electrical → cafeteria → weapons → security → navigation → storage → lower engine.

Only person I saw this round was Charlie in storage at tick 27, right before I went to lower engine and found the body. I didn’t see anyone else near lower engine, and I didn’t see the kill happen. Charlie is the only person I can place nearby, but I’m not hard accusing yet — just giving the info.

My route was weapons → security → navigation → storage → lower engine → upper engine → oxygen.

I saw Charlie early in security around tick 5, nothing suspicious there. I saw Diana enter storage from navigation around tick 15. Then at tick 20, both Bob and Diana entered lower engine from storage, and I saw both of them in lower engine at ticks 20 and 21. After that I left toward upper engine and then oxygen, where I saw Eve around ticks 26-27.

So the biggest thing from my info is: Diana was alive in lower engine with Bob at tick 20/21. I didn’t see the kill happen, but Bob was the last person I personally saw with her in the room where the body was found. Frank seeing Charlie in storage at tick 27 is useful, but I’d really like to hear Bob’s route and when he left lower engine.

Alice is spot on about the early timeline. I was in lower engine around tick 20 with both Alice and Diana. Alice left toward upper engine, and I followed shortly after, heading up to upper engine and then oxygen. Diana was completely fine when I left her alone in lower engine.

After oxygen, I looped back down through storage, medbay, and ended up in the cafeteria. 

Given that the body was found at tick 29, there's a huge 8-9 tick window where anyone could have walked into lower engine after I left. Frank bringing up Charlie in storage at tick 27 is super relevant, since storage is directly connected to lower engine and that's right before the report. Charlie, we really need to hear what you were doing. I'm not locking my vote yet, but I definitely didn't touch Diana.

My route was navigation → security → weapons → cafeteria → oxygen → upper engine → medbay → storage. I never went into lower engine this round.

What I saw: Alice left security toward navigation around tick 5. I saw Eve in weapons ticks 7-9, then Eve left weapons toward security at tick 10. Much later, I was in storage, and Frank entered storage from navigation at tick 27 — that matches him saying he saw me there before going to lower engine and reporting.

So yeah, Frank can place me in storage at 27, but I did not go down to lower engine. I was just in storage doing my cargo task. From Alice’s info, Diana was alive in lower engine with Bob at ticks 20-21, and Bob is the last confirmed person actually in the room with her. Bob saying “anyone could’ve walked in” is technically possible, but he’s also the one with the clearest opportunity, and now he’s trying to push suspicion onto me just because I was in storage nearby later.

I’m leaning Bob here unless Eve has something that clears him.

I can add a few confirmations but I didn’t see lower engine myself.

My route was medbay → cafeteria → weapons → security → navigation → back through security/weapons/cafeteria → oxygen. I saw Bob early in medbay ticks 2-4, so nothing that clears him for the lower engine timing. I saw Charlie in weapons ticks 8-10, which matches his route. I saw Frank enter security from weapons at tick 21, and I saw Alice in oxygen at tick 26, then she left oxygen toward cafeteria at 27.

So from my POV: Alice is pretty well accounted for late and far from lower engine. Charlie being in storage at 27 is near the body, but Frank also saw him there and then immediately found/report lower engine, and Charlie’s story matches what I saw earlier. Bob is still the last confirmed person actually in lower engine with Diana at ticks 20-21, and I don’t have any sighting that clears him after that.

I’m leaning Bob based on opportunity and the timeline.

After hearing everyone, I’m leaning Bob.

My own info is limited: I found Diana dead in lower engine at tick 29, and the only person I saw nearby was Charlie in storage at tick 27. But Alice’s info is the strongest: she saw Bob and Diana together in lower engine at ticks 20-21, which is exactly where the body ended up. Bob says he left her alive, but nobody has cleared him after that.

Charlie was near storage late, yes, but I saw him there, not in lower engine, and his route lines up with Eve’s earlier sightings. Bob is the last confirmed person actually with Diana in the kill room, and his defense is mostly shifting suspicion to Charlie.

I think Bob is the best vote here.

I’ll restate my key info since it really matters here: I saw Bob and Diana both enter lower engine from storage at tick 20, and I saw them both still in lower engine at ticks 20-21. That’s the exact room where Diana’s body was found.

After that, I left toward upper engine and oxygen, and I saw Eve in oxygen around ticks 26-27, so Eve was far from lower engine late. Charlie I only saw early in security, and while Frank saw Charlie in storage at tick 27, that still doesn’t put Charlie inside lower engine.

Bob is the last confirmed person actually with Diana in the kill room. His defense is basically “anyone could’ve walked in later,” but nobody has confirmed him leaving safely or being elsewhere right after. Based on everyone’s info, I’m strongly leaning Bob.

Listen, I know Alice's info makes me look like the obvious suspect, but you guys are completely ignoring the actual kill window and a massive red flag. 

Alice, yes, we were both in lower engine at T20-21. I am not denying that. But I left right after you did to head up to upper engine. If I had killed Diana at T21, that means her body just sat there for 8 full ticks while everyone was running around the left side of the map? That makes no sense.

Now look at Charlie. Frank, you literally saw Charlie in storage at tick 27, and you found the body at tick 29. Storage is the *only* entrance to lower engine. Charlie had the perfect window to step into lower engine, kill Diana, and step back out just before you arrived. Charlie is using my earlier presence in the room as a convenient scapegoat to cover his own tracks. 

Eve, you know I’ve been honest about my early route since we saw each other in medbay at ticks 2-4. Please, look at the timeline logically. Why would the killer be me from T21 when Charlie was spotted right outside the crime scene at T27? I am voting Charlie. If you vote me out and the game doesn't end, you'll know exactly who to look at tomorrow.

Bob’s argument doesn’t really work with the timing. Frank saw me in storage at tick 27, and then reported in lower engine at tick 29. Storage to lower engine takes basically that whole window. For me to be the killer, I’d have to leave storage immediately, arrive lower engine right as Frank is arriving, kill Diana, and somehow not be seen by Frank. I was in storage doing cargo when he came through.

Also, Bob saying storage is the only entrance is wrong — lower engine also connects to upper engine, which is exactly the direction Bob says he left after being alone with Diana. Alice saw Bob and Diana in lower engine at ticks 20-21, the exact room where the body was found, and nobody has cleared Bob after that.

I think Bob is pushing me because I was nearby late, but “nearby” isn’t the same as “in the room with the victim.” Bob was the last confirmed person with Diana in lower engine. I’m voting Bob.

I’m still on Bob here.

My confirmed sightings don’t clear Bob after medbay early — I only saw him ticks 2-4, way before the kill window. I can confirm Charlie was in weapons ticks 8-10, and Frank was in security at 21. I also saw Alice in oxygen at 26, and she left toward cafeteria at 27, so Alice being near lower engine late doesn’t fit.

The key points for me are:

- Alice saw Bob and Diana together in lower engine at 20-21, which is where the body was found.
- Bob says he left toward upper engine and oxygen, but nobody has actually confirmed him after that.
- Charlie being in storage at 27 is close, but Frank saw him there and then immediately reported in lower engine at 29. That’s a much tighter and less convincing kill window than Bob being alone with Diana earlier in the actual room.
- Bob also tried to say storage was the only entrance to lower engine, which isn’t true.

I don’t think Charlie is impossible, but Bob has the clearest opportunity and the weakest confirmed alibi after being with Diana. I’m voting Bob.
